title: API Error Handling
summary: Clients should branch on HTTP status, parse structured error bodies, and retry transient failures responsibly.
objectives: Explain API Error Handling in practical web-development terms
Recognize how Web Essentials connects to HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Apply safe habits and avoid common mistakes

content.md: Distinguish **4xx** (fix request) from **5xx** (server/transient). Use backoff for 503/timeouts; never log tokens in client console in production builds.

quickRecap: Practice with the quiz — execution on device is limited to HTML/CSS/JS in the playground.

exercise.prompt: Review the example, then open the playground only when the lesson uses HTML/CSS/JS starter code. Complete the quiz to earn XP.
